summary: G: is mounted and every requested Vault page exists and was read. The binding contracts split cleanly across six topics. (a) Kimi is NOT a provider anywhere: the code source-of-truth DEFAULT_AGENT_REGISTRY (agent_router.py) and every contract lists exactly four seats — codex, claude, gemini(=agy), owner — and Company Structure fixes "drei ... AIs"; adding Kimi requires a code registry row plus annexes to the routing table, agent_chain.v1.json vendor+critic map, the 2026-09-15 cross-vendor annex, and Company Structure. (b) ML: HR14 (Hard Rules) currently forbids ML blanket ("alles verboten") with OWNER-written exception only, and R4 (qb_reputable_source_criteria.md, echoed in Research Methodology) calls it "Nicht relaxbar" — but the Edge Lab Charter already states the exact ULTRACODE distinction ("No ML inside the EA ... the AIs are the research/development tools, never a model embedded in the EA") and START_HERE rule 8 is EA-scoped ("V5-EAs sind mechanisch"); ULTRACODE generalizes the EA-scoping and needs annexes on HR14 and R4. (c) R1 already admits AI-authored sources (source_id: AI-<agent>-...-<date> with prompt/output trail in strategy-seeds/sources/), so Kimi authoring fits, but the new QM-RESEARCH://<id> URI scheme and Kimi as a valid <agent> tag need an annex on the criteria file and the Research Methodology R1 row; note the standing "agy video-links are NOT R1 evidence (hallucination precedent)" guard. (d) Quota governance names only Codex+Claude weekly limits and three flags (CODEX_LOW_TOKENS/CLAUDE_DISABLED/AGY_LOW_QUOTA), backtests never throttled — no Kimi lane/flag exists. (e) Determinism-Over-LLM-Calls binds any new LLM use: reasoning/synthesis only, deterministic result artifacts, which is exactly why ULTRACODE's offline-ML-in-research must terminate in mechanical rules + a durable auditable artifact. (f) Research Methodology (depth-first, one source at a time, HR16) and the Lessons-Learned Loop (daily, lessons become scripts/pre-flight not memory) govern how a Kimi-authored strategy enters the funnel. Truth precedence honored: code registry beats the contract table (they currently agree). No verdicts, files, or T_Live touched — read-only throughout.

risks: HR14 as written is blanket ('alles verboten') and EA-agnostic; if ULTRACODE's 'ML allowed offline in research' is applied by reading intent rather than by a signed annex, an agent could justify PnL-adaptive or online-learning logic that R4 still forbids inside the EA. The annex must state the EA-vs-research boundary explicitly and preserve R4's non-relaxable in-EA list verbatim.

R1 already permits AI-authored sources but the guard 'agy video-links are NOT R1 evidence (hallucination precedent)' shows the org's fear of ungrounded AI citations. A QM-RESEARCH://<id> artifact authored by Kimi must be durable, content-addressed and independently readable (not a transient chat log) or it recreates the hallucination-as-source failure mode.

Adding Kimi touches code that has fail-closed DB triggers (agent_registry requires canonical router generation) and a cross-vendor critic map that assumes exactly three AI vendors; a partial add (contract annex without the code registry row + agent_chain vendor entry + a KIMI quota flag) would leave Kimi unroutable or unthrottled, and unthrottled AI spend violates the quota-governance contract.

Company Structure hard-codes 'drei ... AIs' and the cost-model/quota governor only knows Codex+Claude weekly limits; a Kimi seat with no governor lane and no spend flag would run outside the only mechanism that enforces the weekly budget line.

Truth-precedence trap: the routing-contract table and the code registry currently agree, but they are two surfaces. If Kimi is added to the Vault table (or CLAUDE.md prose) but not to DEFAULT_AGENT_REGISTRY, the code wins and Kimi silently does not exist as a lane.
unknowns: The exact full ULTRACODE directive text (OWNER 2026-09-15) was not present in the repo or Vault at audit time (grep for 'kimi|moonshot' and 'ultracode' in decisions/ found no dedicated decision file). The directive's precise wording, DL number, and whether it has been written into decisions/ or the OWNER-Entscheidungsregister is UNKNOWN — I audited the CURRENT contracts it would amend, not the directive itself.

Whether a QM-RESEARCH://<id> resolver/store already exists (path, format, content-addressing) is UNKNOWN — the scheme appears nowhere in the read files; strategy-seeds/sources/<source_id>/ is the only existing AI-source artifact location referenced.

The concrete quota/pacing figures for a Kimi/Moonshot seat (weekly limit, cost_rank, a KIMI_LOW_TOKENS-style flag) are UNKNOWN — no such config exists; agent_quota_gate.v1.json was listed but not opened line-by-line.

Whether 'Kimi may author internal strategies' is meant to grant Kimi a routable research/strategy lane (like gemini/agy) or only an offline authoring role feeding an existing seat is not resolvable from the current contracts alone.

The gate_manifest.v4.json carries no R1/ML criteria text (gates are function-named only); ML/R1 enforcement lives in qb_reputable_source_criteria.md + agent_router.py schema + Q00, so no gate-manifest annex is implied — but whether ULTRACODE intends any gate-level change is UNKNOWN.
